<quote by="Announced by Ciapek Splintered Oak, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave">Self-funded construction of a wayhouse in Utterlund, Holberg. We are providing 16 wains of white granite and 48 crowns. It will be named The Splintered House
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[Navarr wayhouse|wayhouse]] in Utterlund, Holberg
* Announcement by the [[Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave]]

==Date==
* Winter 387YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 16 wains of white granite
* 1152 rings in labour costs (increased by being built in a marsh)
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Wayhouse_in_Holberg}}
==Outcome==
Now completed, the wayhouse has had the following effects:
* Navarr will be able to take a personal resource in Holberg without suffering the foreign nation penalty.
* The [[Keeper of the Splintered House]] will be available to appoint by unanimous decision of the senators of Navarr for the first time at the Spring Equinox 388YE
